identity.name: Rare SSH Session with C2 Communication
identity.summary: An attacker initiates an SSH session to a Linux host and executes a payload that communicates with a C2 server. Cortex detects this rare SSH session behavior and the subsequent C2 communication.

biocs.name: SSH Session with Unusual C2 Communication
biocs.description: Detection of SSH session followed by outbound C2 communication
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter actor_process_image_name = 'sshd'
| filter action_process_image_name = 'wget'
| filter action_remote_ip = '192.0.2.10'
